elements.element: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an affiliate.
elements.evidence: Section 15 expressly provides that no approval is required for Client's assignment to an affiliate.

elements.element: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to a successor in a merger.
elements.evidence: The approval requirement expressly does not apply to Client's assignment to a successor in a merger.

elements.element: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to a successor in an acquisition.
elements.evidence: The approval requirement expressly does not apply to Client's assignment to a successor in an acquisition.

elements.element: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to a successor in a sale of substantially all assets.
elements.evidence: The approval requirement expressly does not apply to Client's assignment to a successor in a sale of substantially all assets.

elements.element: Vendor may not assign or transfer without Customer's consent.
elements.evidence: Neither party may assign or transfer without the other party's prior written approval, and the exceptions apply only to Client.

elements.element: Customer's consent to a Vendor assignment may not be unreasonably withheld.
elements.evidence: The clause states that Client's approval of an assignment or transfer by TrueLink shall not be unreasonably withheld.

elements.element: Vendor may not assign or transfer the Agreement to a Customer competitor.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly prohibits TrueLink from assigning or transferring the Agreement to a competitor of Client.

elements.element: Vendor has no termination right triggered by Customer's change of control.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that TrueLink has no right to terminate as a result of a change of control of Client.

elements.element: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to a successor.
elements.evidence: Client may assign without approval to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets.

elements.element: Customer must provide Vendor written notice of an assignment to a successor.
elements.evidence: No notice requirement applies to Client's permitted successor assignments.

elements.element: Vendor may assign without Customer consent to a successor.
elements.evidence: The successor exception applies only to Client; TrueLink remains subject to Client's prior written approval.

elements.element: Vendor must provide Customer written notice of an assignment to a successor.
elements.evidence: The clause provides no notice-based successor assignment right for TrueLink.

elements.element: Customer assignments other than assignments to a successor require Vendor consent.
elements.evidence: Client may also assign to an affiliate without TrueLink's consent, even though an affiliate assignment need not be a successor assignment.

elements.element: Vendor's consent to Customer assignments other than assignments to a successor may not be unreasonably withheld.
elements.evidence: The clause does not restrict TrueLink from unreasonably withholding approval of Client assignments requiring approval.

elements.element: Vendor assignments other than assignments to a successor require Customer consent.
elements.evidence: All TrueLink assignments or transfers require Client's prior written approval; TrueLink has no successor exception.

elements.element: Customer's consent to Vendor assignments other than assignments to a successor may not be unreasonably withheld.
elements.evidence: Client's approval of an assignment or transfer by TrueLink expressly may not be unreasonably withheld.

result.reason: The operative redline fully implements the preferred position. It is not a complete fallback because it lacks written notice for Customer successor assignments, gives Vendor no consent-free successor right, retains a separate Customer affiliate carve-out, and does not make Vendor's consent to Customer assignments subject to a reasonableness standard. The changes are confined to the assignment provision and do not disturb unrelated commercial terms.
